title: TRACE analysis of the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence

release_scope.catalog_construction: Scripts and selected workflow materials for preprocessing, phase picking, association, and relocation.
release_scope.catalog_analysis: Prompts, generated scripts, and selected result summaries for spatiotemporal, fault, b-value, and Omori-Utsu analyses.
release_scope.excluded: Raw waveforms, large input datasets, complex intermediate tables, caches, and local runtime directories. The compact final manuscript catalog and selected diagnostics are retained.

data_requirements.name: continuous_waveforms
data_requirements.description: SCEDC continuous waveform data for 2019-07-04 through 2019-07-26; required for catalog generation.

data_requirements.name: station_metadata
data_requirements.description: StationXML metadata for the selected Ridgecrest stations.

data_requirements.name: reference_catalog
data_requirements.description: USGS ComCat CI catalog used as an external reference.

data_requirements.name: fault_geometry
data_requirements.description: Ridgecrest fault geometry used by fault-oriented analyses.
